vendor_comparison: IDV Provider Stack Analysis
date: 2026-10-03

liveness_detection_approach:
  passive_only: Veriff
  active_and_passive: Jumio, Onfido, AU10TIX, Socure
  notes: Active challenge prompts (blink, head turn, speak) are harder to defeat with static presentations (masks, printed media). Passive-only requires stronger anti-spoofing models.

3d_depth_validation:
  explicitly_mentioned: Onfido (3D face mapping)
  implied_in_stack: AU10TIX, Socure (facial analysis)
  not_explicitly_disclosed: Veriff, Jumio, IDology
  notes: 3D depth detection is difficult for attackers using 2D masks or printed media to replicate.

document_authenticity_depth:
  highest_detail: AU10TIX (5000+ document types, NFC chip reading, 180+ forensic tests)
  comprehensive: Onfido (microprint, security features, compression artifact detection)
  standard: Veriff, Jumio, IDology
  notes: NFC chip reading provides direct chip-level authenticity validation.

deepfake_and_synthetic_media:
  explicit_focus: Socure (Sigma Synthetic Fraud), AU10TIX (AI-generated media detection)
  mentioned: Veriff, Onfido
  implied: Jumio, IDology

device_and_session_integrity:
  explicitly_detailed: Veriff (device/browser/network fingerprinting, session API)
  mentioned: IDology (device fingerprinting), AU10TIX (REST API)
  not_explicitly_disclosed: Jumio, Onfido, Socure

fraud_intelligence_and_consortium:
  emphasized: IDology (consortium network), AU10TIX (consortium validation)
  mentioned: Veriff (anomaly detection)
  not_explicitly_disclosed: Jumio, Onfido, Socure

manual_review_and_escalation:
  explicitly_mentioned: AU10TIX (DoubleCheck for edge cases)
  implied: Veriff, IDology, Onfido
  not_explicitly_disclosed: Jumio, Socure

pad_compliance:
  iBeta PAD Level 2: Jumio, Onfido
  ISO/IEC 30107-3 (generic): Veriff
  not_explicitly_mentioned: Socure, IDology, AU10TIX
  notes: iBeta testing is independent third-party validation; lack of disclosure does not mean absence.

vulnerability_to_combined_attacks:
  mask_plus_printed_card_plus_compression:
    
    veriff:
      liveness_risk: Passive-only; may struggle with high-quality mask if anti-spoofing model weak on degraded media
      document_risk: Hologram detection is image-analysis based; printed card with realistic mask photo might pass
      combined_risk: High if anti-spoofing fails on compressed input and document check is weak on printed forgeries
    
    jumio:
      liveness_risk: Active prompts (blink, head turn) hard for mask to perform; lower risk if mask cannot respond
      document_risk: Similar to Veriff; printed document vulnerability depends on implementation
      combined_risk: Lower than Veriff if active prompts enforced; mask struggle with dynamic challenges
    
    onfido:
      liveness_risk: Active challenge + 3D face mapping; 3D depth detection very hard for 2D mask
      document_risk: Microprint, compression artifact detection; printed forgeries may be caught
      combined_risk: Lower; 3D validation and active challenges significantly harder to defeat
    
    au10tix:
      liveness_risk: Passive and active options; if active enforced, mask struggle similar to Jumio
      document_risk: NFC chip reading provides direct authenticity (if real ID used with chip)
      combined_risk: Lower if active liveness enforced and NFC check available; chip reading defeats printed forgeries
    
    socure:
      liveness_risk: Behavioral analysis hard for mask to replicate; micro-expression detection difficult for static media
      document_risk: Document checks implied but not deeply disclosed
      combined_risk: Lower due to behavioral and micro-expression signals; mask very limited in this domain
    
    idology:
      liveness_risk: Multi-layered data matching includes behavioral and geolocation signals
      document_risk: Document verification + face matching; behavioral signals hard to spoof
      combined_risk: Lower if behavioral and geo-signals are enforced; masks limited in behavioral domain

notes:
- Printed card defeat is likely if document verification relies on OCR and basic image checks
- Mask defeat depends on: (1) active vs passive liveness, (2) 3D depth detection, (3) behavioral signals
- Upload compression can degrade anti-spoofing models if not trained on compressed media
- Highest risk: Passive-only liveness + basic document checks
- Lowest risk: Active challenge + 3D validation + behavioral signals + NFC/chip
